snippet.title: Kingdom Ascension | Gameplay PC
snippet.description:
"Kingdom Ascension" is a medieval-themed strategy war game. You will become a lord and build your own territory from scratch. Through resource collection, building construction, troop recruitment, exploration and adventure, you will continue to expand your territory and defend your homeland

Starting from a desolate base, collect key resources such as food and materials. In the case of limited resources, you need to be prudent and reasonably allocate resources for troop training, building upgrades and technology research and development to lay the foundation for development.

Develop the technology tree to improve economic efficiency and scale. Focus on upgrading the performance and role of war equipment. These key skills will have a decisive impact on the battle situation. Continuously strengthen your strength through scientific research.

Create a dedicated army to resist invasion. Recruit soldiers with different characteristics and flexibly combine them according to tactical needs. The outcome of the battlefield depends on your deployment, combination of soldiers and tactical arrangements.

Send troops to explore the dynamic map to discover treasures, ruins and unknown enemies. Unlock new territories through battles or acquisitions, accumulate more resources, gradually expand the territory, and respond to challenges brought by random events, with the goal of becoming a hegemon.
